Bank-Math-Master.question: ১) If x - 2 = √3 then what is the value of x<sup>4</sup> + (1/x)<sup>4</sup>?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If x - 2 = √3 then what is the value of x4 + (1/x)4?

Solution:
Given,
x - 2 = √3
⇒ x = 2 + √3

∴ (1/x) = 2 - √3

∴ x + (1/x) = 2 + √3 + 2 - √3 = 4

∴ x2 + (1/x2) = {x + (1/x)}2 - 2 . x . (1/x)
= (4)2 - 2
= 16 - 2
= 14

∴ x4 + (1/x)4 = {x2 + (1/x2)}2 - 2. x2. (1/x2)
= (14)2 - 2
= 196 - 2
= 194

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২) If a + 1/a = √5 what is the value of a<sup>3</sup> + 1/(a<sup>3</sup>)?

Question: If a + 1/a = √5 what is the value of a3 + 1/(a3)?

Solution:
Given,
a + 1/a = √5

We know,
a3 + 1/a3 = (a + 1/a)3 - 3. a. 1/a. (a + 1/a)
= (√5)3 - 3 × √5
= 5√5 - 3√5
= 2√5

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৭) If a + b + c = 9, a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> = 29 then what is the value of (ab + bc + ca) = ?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If a + b + c = 9, a2 + b2 + c2 = 29 then what is the value of (ab + bc + ca) = ?

Solution:
Given,
a + b + c = 9,
a2 + b2 + c2 = 29

We know,
(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)
⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = (a + b + c)2 - (a2 + b2 + c2)
⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = (9)2 - 29
⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 81 - 29
⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 52
∴ (ab + bc + ca) = 26

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৯) What should be the value of "P" so that the expression (9 − 12x + Px<sup>2</sup>) becomes a perfect square?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: What should be the value of "P" so that the expression (9 − 12x + Px2) becomes a perfect square?

Solution:
(9 − 12x + Px2)
= (3)2 − 2 × 3 × 2x + (2x)2 + Px2 - (2x)2
= (3 - 2x)2 + Px2 - 4x2

∴ the expression becomes a perfect square if,
Px2 - 4x2 = 0
⇒ Px2 = 4x2
∴ P = 4

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১০) Four girls are sitting on a bench to be photographed. Seema is to the left of Rani. Mary is to the right of Rani. Rita is between Rani and Mary. Who would be third from the left in the photograph?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Four girls are sitting on a bench to be photographed. Seema is to the left of Rani. Mary is to the right of Rani. Rita is between Rani and Mary. Who would be third from the left in the photograph?

Solution:
Seema is to the left of Rani.
Seema ⇔ Rani

Mary is to the right of Rani.
Rani ⇔ Mary

Rita is between Rani and Mary.
Rani ⇔ Rita ⇔ Mary

∴ Seema ⇔ Rani ⇔ Rita ⇔ Mary.

Rita would be third from the left in the photograph

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১১) If x<sup>2</sup> + yz + zx + xy is divided by x + y, the result is-

Question: If x2 + yz + zx + xy is divided by x + y, the result is-

Solution:
x2 + yz + zx + xy
= x2 + xy + zx + yz
= x(x + y) + z(x + y)
= (x + y)(x + z)

∴ divided by (x + y) the result = (x + y)(x + z)/(x +y) = (x + z)

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৩) If a + b = 7 and ab = 12, then  what is the value of (1/a<sup>2</sup>) + (1/b<sup>2</sup>)?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If a + b = 7 and ab = 12, then  what is the value of (1/a2) + (1/b2)?

Solution:
Given,
a + b = 7 and ab = 12

∴ (1/a2) + (1/b2)
= (b2 + a2)/(a2b2)
= (a2 + b2)/(a2b2)
= {(a + b)2 - 2ab}/(ab)2
= {(7)2 - (2 × 12)}/(12)2
= (49 - 24)/144
= 25/144

Solution:

a = b = 2c
∴ a = b 
and b = 2c
⇒ c = b/2

ATQ,
abc = 256
⇒ b × b × (b/2) = 256
⇒ b3/2 = 256

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৬) If x = 3 + 2√2 then, what is the value of x<sup>-1</sup>?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If x = 3 + 2√2 then, what is the value of x-1?

Solution:
Given,
x = 3 + 2√2
∴ 1/x = 1/(3 + 2√2)
⇒ x-1 = (3 - 2√2)/(3 + 2√2)(3 - 2√2)
= (3 - 2√2)/(3)2 - (2√2)2
= (3 - 2√2)/(9 - 8)
∴ x-1 = (3 - 2√2)

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৭) If x<sup>2</sup> - √5.x + 1 = 0 then, x<sup>2</sup> + 1/x<sup>2</sup> = ?

Question: If x2 - √5.x + 1 = 0 then, x2 + 1/x2 = ?

Solution:
Given,
x2 - √5.x + 1 = 0
⇒ x2 + 1 = √5.x
⇒ x2/x + 1/x = (√5.x)/x
⇒ x + 1/x = √5

Now,
x2 + 1/x2 = (x + 1/x)2 - 2. x.1/x
= (√5)2 - 2
= 5 - 2
= 3
